methodological_caveats: Static shadow portfolios reused over ten future draws; this is NOT the rolling P2 strategy.
The 35-checkpoint P3e historic experiment is retrospective and cannot substitute for a prospectively sealed test.
All three valid four-disjoint strategies have identical fair IID per-draw winning probability; any difference over 10 draws is noisy.
Multiple model families were previously explored; Bonferroni only covers the two named P2 arms.
No wager or new ticket purchase follows from this manifest. No actual future outcomes are stored in this file.
